text: In 2010, a young boy from London was sitting in a bedroom in a farm and he only paid $1 trillion in 5 minutes in America. Neither a big firm nor a Wall Street background. He was a new singer. He was a middle class family member from Punjab who was trading with his parents. But his face was not from humans. He was a super fast robot from Wall Street. But HFUNs had put AI bots in the market. This was a profit of the farm traders. He was a slave to the Nav coin machines and systems. He learned to play FIFA games and catch patterns. Nav hired a coder and made a software that would give the system a price. He put fake sell orders in the market in the software. As the robots were buying the price of the panic Nav bought it in the system and the fake orders were cancelled. In 2006, 2010, Nav turned on his system full power. On Wall Street, he was in panic that a thousand points in Dow Jones fell in a thousand points. The world knows this flash crash. Navinder earned $50 million in total. He earned $400 crore. But he saw a kiss. He paid all his money in one incident. In 2015, FBI arrested him with the same bedroom. To save a big billionaire, a man made a fool of a man. Without any big degree, he had filled the whole Wall Street. So, Nav was a criminal or a modern genius.
